Labelmode: id: 5-digit ID. coords: pixel coordinates. both: ID and coordinates.
Labelcolor: Colour of the labels: red or white.
Fontsize: Label height in pixels; steps in multiples of 7.
Boxsize: Size of the square boxes around points, in pixels.
Linecount: Number of connecting lines between points.
Gridsize: Spacing of the background grid in pixels.
Threshold: Brightness a pixel needs to be accepted as a feature point.
Refresh: How many times per 8 s cycle the point selection is re-seeded. 0 = never.
Jitter: Amount of periodic jitter on the points.
Dim: Brightness of the input image under the HUD. 1 = unchanged.
Scanlines: Strength of the scanline overlay. 0 = off.
Modamount: Scales the modulation CHOP (in2): band1 moves Jitter, band2 moves Boxsize. 0 = ignore.
Mix: Blend between the input (0) and the effect (1).
Bypass: Pass in1 through unchanged; the effect does not cook.
Resolutionmode: input: follow in1's resolution (or the demo source when unconnected). custom: use Resolution.
Resolution: Output size in pixels when Resolutionmode is custom.
